import polars as pl


def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    return raw.select(
        employee_id=pl.col("EMPNO").str.to_uppercase(),
        employee_name=pl.col("NAME"),
        work_date=pl.col("WORKDATE").str.to_date(format="%Y%m%d", strict=False),
        project_code=pl.col("PROJ").str.to_uppercase(),
        hours_normal=pl.col("NRM").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2),
        hours_overtime=pl.col("OVT").cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2),
    )
